parameters.query: SELECT * FROM trading.v_news_evidence_cases WHERE $1::date IS NULL OR news_date < $1::date;

INSERT INTO trading.news_evidence_lookups
  (news_id, ticker, news_category, sektor, as_of_date, match_tier, sample_size, confounded_count, distinct_ticker_count, evidence_sufficient, matched_case_ids, confounded_case_ids, stats_json)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::date, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11::bigint[], $12::bigint[], $13::jsonb)
RETURNING id;
